_comment: C0-16 正文英译 · consensus（2026-10-25）。无附加小节。正文「相关条目」3 行带 .md 链接（elicit/notebooklm/metaso），related 写 3 条（frontmatter related 是 [elicit, notebooklm, metaso, chatgpt]，键按正文链接行对齐=3）。sources 3 条对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: An in-house index of 400M+ peer-reviewed papers, fed by Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, PubMed and publisher feeds. Retrieval uses hybrid vector-plus-lexical ranking, weighted by study design, sample size, citations and recency. LLMs produce summaries and synthesis. The Consensus Meter classifies the first 20 results of a yes/no question as supporting, refuting or mixed (2026-11-21).
axes.runtime: Web at consensus.app, iOS/Android apps, a REST API (`docs.consensus.app`), a remote MCP server (`https://mcp.consensus.app/mcp`) and ChatGPT/Claude integrations all work. Retrieval and generation run in the vendor cloud (2026-11-21).
axes.local_files: My Library, Collections, uploaded documents and Threads live account-side in the cloud; uploads are private to the account. Citation exports in BibTeX, RIS, EndNote and CSV plus PDFs land locally. The API returns structured JSON with citation metadata (2026-11-21).
axes.background: Research Agent plans searches, chains tools and applies academic filters. Deep Review synthesises 50–100 papers in one pass, a platform-side multi-step task with progress in the web app. API and MCP calls are independent, with batch screening orchestrated by the caller (2026-11-21).
axes.tools: Paper search, cited AI synthesis and the Consensus Meter come first. There are filters by study type, year, journal, open access and discipline. Study Snapshot covers methods, sample and outcomes. Also included: Chat with Full Text, My Library/Collections, Threads, Citation Graph, Deep Reviews, REST API and MCP (2026-11-21).
axes.context: Threads keep follow-up context within one conversation. Library and Collections persist papers and uploads. No cross-session user profile is built. Clearing thread history deletes searches and associated conversations; deleting the account revokes integration access (2026-11-21).
axes.permissions: Accounts plus Free, Pro, Deep, Teams and Enterprise subscriptions. REST uses a bearer API key; MCP uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic registration. A low-quota anonymous tier exists. API and MCP share a monthly call pool: Free 30, Pro/Team/Enterprise 500 (up to 1,000), Deep 2,000 (up to 10,000), then $0.05 per call (2026-11-21).
axes.fit: Fit: evidence questions of the “what does the science say” kind, literature screening and polarity snapshots, cited academic search for agents, and citation export. Not fit: treating the Meter as a verdict, full-text systematic-review screening, or Chinese-first literature (2026-11-21).

runs: This entry checks the official llms-full file, help centre, API page and privacy policy. Meter bias, post-filter statistics and Free/Pro boundaries need a shared question set.
unknowns:
- Index size and sources: the official llms-full cites 400M+ papers from Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, PubMed and publisher feeds.
- Terms details: check the official terms page.
- Training-use controls: the privacy policy states no training, and the terms licence is limited to service processing.
- Chinese literature coverage: measure Chinese versus English on a shared question set.
related: Also scientific-literature oriented: Consensus gives quick polarity reads, Elicit does deep extraction for reviews.
Complementary: Consensus finds literature and gives polarity, NotebookLM digs deep inside the sources you pick.
Chinese academic counterpart: Metaso's academic tier searches Chinese libraries, Consensus works the English empirical pool.
